done_when: The upgrade's synced-files check compares only files git tracks in the fix, so hook files that are never committed (such as .husky/_) never block close, while a stale tracked file still does; a test runs forge close on an upgrade whose test command rewrites an untracked hook file and sees it reach Ready
why: An upgrade can't close when the repo's own test run rewrites git-hook files that are never committed, because the synced-files check compares them
